name: LCBP Healthy Ecosystems habitat and native species grants
summary: Annual small and large grants for on-the-ground wetland, riparian and aquatic habitat work and native species conservation in the Lake Champlain Basin, funded through EPA money passed via NEIWPCC.

amount.note: Small category up to $50,000; large category $50,001-$175,000

status.quote: Proposals due to LCBP October 23, 2026 at 5:00 PM via Foundant

deadline.quote: Proposals due to LCBP October 23, 2026 at 5:00 PM via Foundant

geography.quote: preserve, restore, or improve native species habitat in the Lake Champlain Basin

access.quote: One proposal per category may be submitted per eligible organization or entity.

window.quote: Recurring/Annual Grants Release Date Due Date

amount.quote: Grants of up to $50,000 will be awarded in the Healthy Ecosystems - Habitat and Native Species (HE-HNS) Small grant category. Grants between $50,001-$175,000 will be awarded in the HE-HNS Large grant category.
